worldcombat.skill.luckychant.summary: Chants toward the sky, and a sky-light covers the caster and nearby allies; while it holds, attacks on them never land as critical hits. The light follows the caster, and anyone who leaves its reach loses the blessing.
worldcombat.skill.luckychant.use.0: Shut down high damage that relies on critical hits
worldcombat.skill.luckychant.use.1: Cover the team's soft or low-health members
worldcombat.skill.luckychant.use.2: Sing it before the foe starts its combo
worldcombat.skill.luckychant.description: The sky-light covers the caster and allies within %2$s blocks for %1$s: critical hits from opposing attacks are smoothed out — damage settles as a normal hit and the critical mark is cleared.
the current cast range is %1$s blocks. It only stops criticals, not ordinary damage or control.
Singing it takes %1$s, the recovery is %2$s and the cooldown %3$s. See the wish note for the early/deep trade-off.
worldcombat.skill.luckychant.wish.0: Early wish: -3 ticks wind-up and x0.85 cooldown, at x0.85 radius and x0.7 duration — quick to sing and refresh, but smaller and shorter.
worldcombat.skill.luckychant.wish.1: Deep wish: radius x1.2 and duration x1.3, at +3 ticks wind-up and x1.15 cooldown — wide and long, but slower and costlier.
worldcombat.skill.luckychant.timing: Cast on yourself: after %2$s of preparation it spends %4$s PP; the recovery is %3$s and the cooldown %5$s from commit.
Early wish: radius x0.85, duration x0.7, in exchange for -3 ticks wind-up and x0.85 cooldown — good to re-sing in a fast fight. Deep wish: radius x1.2, duration x1.3, at +3 ticks wind-up and x1.15 cooldown — good to cover the whole team before the fight.
The partner only considers singing while a threat is this close; smaller keeps it for melee, larger prepares from farther away.
Under pressure: only while a foe is attacking the partner or its owner, or the partner was just hurt. Anytime: cover on any threat.
When on, the partner will also leave its post to sing.
world_combat.move.luckychant.text.guard: The critical is turned aside, saving %1$s
